summary: Iteration 14: Full test of Marketing Team Report + Fair-Share round-robin. 18/18 backend pytest cases pass (presets today/week/month/year/all, custom range label, executive field shape, per-exec + totals conversion_rate calc, .xlsx headers/PK-bytes/size, fair-share distribution across 2+ execs, remarks/avg_response fields, regression: dashboard stats/analytics, inquiries/packages/bills/settings/auth/me). Frontend /marketing renders both tabs, all 6 presets, 4 KPI cards, exec-leaderboard, exec-bar-chart, custom-from/to date inputs, and report-download / report-share-wa / report-share-native buttons. Excel download response verified with correct content-type + Content-Disposition attachment header. Custom range correctly triggers /api/marketing/report?from=...&to=... call. Campaigns tab regression OK (mk-title etc still present).

minor.issue: Response returns `assigned_to` set to the exec NAME (from doc.assigned_to_name), while the stored DB field `assigned_to` holds the exec ID. API contract is inconsistent/misleading — same key name means different things in response vs storage.

integration_issues.issue: The report is re-fetched immediately on each keystroke in the date inputs, causing calls with empty/partial `to` param (e.g. `from=2026-06-01&to=`). Consider debouncing or waiting until both fields are non-empty before firing the request.

Popup URL text begins with `%EF%BF%BD` (Unicode replacement character U+FFFD), suggesting an emoji/character was mangled during string construction of the share text. Cosmetic but visible in WhatsApp preview.

action_items: (Optional) Align webhook response `assigned_to` semantics — either return the ID (matching DB) or rename response field to `assigned_to_name` for clarity.
(Optional) Debounce custom date inputs on /marketing so /api/marketing/report is only called when both from and to are set.
(Optional) Fix corrupted emoji in report-share-wa share text (replacement char at start).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 2028 lines — should be split into routers (auth/users/inquiries/marketing/bills/settings).
Custom range parser uses Mongo string compare on ISO created_at — works because timestamps are `YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS…` lexicographic; keep in mind if created_at format ever changes.
Report endpoint loads up to 50000 inquiries into memory — fine for MVP but should be aggregated in Mongo for scale.
_pick_next_marketing_exec correctly uses least-loaded + rr counter tiebreaker; verified with 2 execs — 6 webhooks distributed evenly (3 each).
seed_data_creation: Created 2 test marketing execs (TEST_FS_Exec_1, TEST_FS_Exec_2) to validate fair-share; created 6 test inquiries + 1 remark inquiry (inquiries cleaned up in-test; test exec users remain — main agent may want to purge them if noise is a concern).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend pytest file test_iter14_marketing_report_fair_share.py is a good regression baseline for /marketing/report + report.xlsx + webhook fair-share. Note webhook response `assigned_to` key returns the NAME not the ID — always fetch from /api/inquiries to get real assigned_to (which is exec.id).
rca of the issue: No blocker RCAs — all backend & frontend flows work. Only cosmetic issue on WA share text emoji encoding (U+FFFD).
